The '''H.A.M. Hideout''' is the base of operations for the [[Humans Against Monsters]] organisation. It is located west of the [[Lumbridge]] [[general store]]. To enter it, the player will need to pick the lock on the [[Trapdoor (H.A.M. Hideout)|trapdoor]] to get in. This can be done with the player's hand, but a [[lockpick]] will increase the player's chance of success. 

==Transportation==
*The fastest way there is using a charged [[Amulet of glory|amulet of glory]] to teleport to [[Draynor Village]] and running east (~33 ticks)
*Teleporting to [[Twiggy O'Korn]] with an [[Achievement diary cape]] and running east (~37 ticks)
*Using [[Lumbridge Teleport]] and running west through the castle, exiting through the gate, and running north-west (~41 ticks)

==Notable features==
*With 15 [[Thieving]], a player may [[pickpocket]] [[H.A.M. members]] for [[H.A.M. clothing]] and other items (including [[Clue scroll (easy)|easy clue scrolls]]).
*If a player is caught thieving H.A.M. members multiple times, there is a chance that said player will be either kicked out of the dungeon or be locked up in the cell with [[Jimmy the Chisel]], which will require the player to lockpick the door to exit. [[Home Teleport]] and other teleports can be used to escape.
*If a player has a high [[Agility]] level, and/or is wearing a full set of H.A.M. robes ([[H.A.M. shirt|shirt]], [[H.A.M. robe|robe]], [[H.A.M. hood|hood]], [[H.A.M. cloak|cloak]], [[H.A.M. logo|logo]], [[H.A.M. boots|boots]], and [[H.a.m. gloves|gloves]]), the player is less likely to be kicked out when caught pickpocketing [[H.A.M._Member#Getting_thrown_out|H.A.M. Members]].

==Storerooms==
{{Main|H.A.M. Storerooms}}
Players who have progressed at least halfway through [[Death to the Dorgeshuun]] can access the secret dungeon inside the hideout. The secret entrance is located just south of the podium.

[[File:H.A.M. Storerooms entrance.png|200px|thumb|Secret entrance to the H.A.M. Storerooms.|none]]
==Quests==
All the following quests are involved with the H.A.M. Hideout:
*[[The Lost Tribe]]
*[[Death to the Dorgeshuun]]
*[[One Small Favour]]

==Personalities==
*[[Sigmund]]
*[[H.A.M. Deacon]]
*[[Johanhus Ulsbrecht]]
*[[Jimmy the Chisel]]

==Monsters==
*[[H.A.M. guard]]

==Trivia==
*If you are involuntarily teleported out of the H.A.M. Hideout, such as through a [[random event]], you will receive a message saying ''"You leave the HAM Fanatics' Camp."''
